key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Where the divider between the sidebar and the detail pane was left. Clamped to a usable range on the way in and on the way out, so neither a hand-edited value nor an odd window state can wedge the sidebar shut.

key.name: show-stopped-containers
key.summary: Include stopped containers in the container tables
key.description: Corresponds to docker ps -a. Off by default, so the tables open onto the containers actually executing; the toggle above each one says how many there are altogether. One setting for both pages that list containers, since it is one question.

key.name: show-untagged-images
key.summary: Include untagged images in the image table
key.description: Untagged images are usually residue left behind when a tag moved elsewhere, so the table opens onto the tagged ones. The toggle above it says how many images there are altogether.

key.name: column-widths
key.summary: Widths the user dragged table columns to
key.description: Keyed by table and then by column title, in pixels. A table or column that no longer exists is ignored at render time rather than removed here, so renaming a column cannot make a stored value invalid. Sort order is deliberately not stored: it lasts for the session only.
